patthana15.68:1.1: niyataṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na niyato na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: aniyataṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na niyato na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: dve.
patthana15.68:2.1: niyataṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na niyato na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: aniyataṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na niyato na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: dve. abyākatamūlaṃ dve. sauttaraduka kusalattike nasauttaraduka nakusalattikaṃ
